summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K on September 30, 2026 responding to a Bloomberg press report titled 'Vale Mulls Raising Over $500 Million in Debut Panda Bond Sale.' The Brazilian mining company, a foreign private issuer, characterized financing-alternative assessments as ordinary-course financial and liability management, stating no decision, approval, or commitment exists regarding any transaction. No terms, advisors, or board recommendation were disclosed. The filing is a press-report clarification, not a special situation; watch for any subsequent Panda bond issuance disclosure.
